ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the type-check command, covered components and suppression setting are declared; it does not show the code type-checks.
offer: Bind the type checker to the repository task and enumerate covered components. Do not make a clean result by suppressing type errors or silently excluding a package.

minimal.reason: Bind the type checker to the repository's typecheck command. A missing command means types are unchecked, so name the real task.

mid.reason: List the components the type checker covers. A silently excluded package hides type errors, so enumerate every covered component.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring type errors to false. Suppressing errors manufactures a clean result, so fix the errors or record them as findings.
